translations.web: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.
translations.bsb: The womb forgets them; the worm feeds on them; they are remembered no more. So injustice is broken like a tree.
translations.kjv: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
